items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: We came back to New York from there. That's when we went to the Capital Theater in New York at 50th Street and Broadway on the bill with Tony DiMarco and Sally.

ctx.x: Did you have any relations with these people? Did you know them intimately or --
No, I had that with Tony DeMarco and Sally -- and what's that last name -- I forgot her last name. However, Tony DeMarco and Ritz Brothers and --
